Have a photo or a memory?

Keep a copy of the image, the names or call signs you recognize, and an approximate date. Once the current website contact is confirmed, those details will help connect the story to the archive.

Need a photo corrected or removed?

The original gallery welcomed correction and removal requests. Until a current website contact is available, ask net control how to reach the site’s maintainer. The recovered pictures here are labeled as historical, not a current member directory.

Good conversations start here.

Give others room to speak, follow net control’s lead, and ask before sharing someone else’s personal details. Welcome unfamiliar call signs as warmly as familiar ones.
